name: Agent Trace
description: A live, animated run view of your agents: every active workspace as a tree of agents and subagents with state, model, tokens, estimated cost and duration, a sequence diagram of the messages between agents, a trace timeline and an event log. Any agent Orca runs shows its state and tool calls; local Claude Code and Codex transcripts add tokens, cost, subagents and orchestration. Read-only and local: no network.

cover.alt: Agent Trace showing two active workspaces as a tree of agent cards above a trace timeline, drawn from sample data

screenshots.alt: All active workspaces: a tree of workspaces, agents and subagents with state, cost and duration, over a trace timeline (sample data)
The Sequence view: one lane per agent, arrows for prompts, subagent calls and orchestration messages between agents in two workspaces (sample data)
One workspace in the light theme: five agents side by side, with model turns, tool calls and a failed call on the timeline (sample data)
The Tokens and cost tab: input, output and cache tokens and estimated cost per agent, grouped by workspace (sample data)
